description: Select files from the file management system with validation and metadata options.

file_path.info: Select one or more files from the file management system.

multiple.info: Whether to allow selecting multiple files.

allowed_extensions.info: Comma-separated list of allowed file extensions (e.g., .pdf,.doc,.txt). Leave empty to allow all types.

include_metadata.info: Whether to include file metadata (size, modified time, etc.) in the output.

validate_existence.info: Whether to validate that the selected file(s) exist on the filesystem.

errors.no_valid_files: No valid files selected. Please check the allowed extensions.

file_type.info: Type of file to read (CSV, Excel, JSON, or Auto-Detect).

has_header.info: Whether the first row contains column headers.

max_rows.info: Maximum number of rows to read (0 for all rows).

sheet_name.info: Name of the Excel worksheet to read.

skip_rows.info: Number of rows to skip from the beginning of the file.
